subject.title: [Feature]: Configurable batching/aggregation of outbound Telegram notifications

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in outbound Telegram notification digest policy, and should it live in the Telegram plugin, shared outbound delivery, or an external plugin/hook surface?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-backed, but the contract affects config shape, delivery timing, urgent error bypass, media/thread semantics, persistence, and the core-versus-plugin boundary.

options.title: Define durable digest policy
options.body: Choose the owner seam, config names, bypass rules, and SQLite-backed flush semantics before implementation.

options.title: Require plugin or hook extension
options.body: Keep core lean and add or document only the hook/API surface needed for an external digest plugin.

options.title: Keep immediate delivery
options.body: Treat throttling, streaming coalescing, and error cooldowns as the supported anti-spam mechanisms and close or narrow the request later.

recommendation.title: Define durable digest policy
recommendation.body: Choose the owner seam, config names, bypass rules, and SQLite-backed flush semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/config/channel-delivery boundary choice, and steipete has the strongest combined routing signal across the affected paths and prior review context.
